To make the competition fair, we have crafted Dota 2 tier list by position. It would not be wise to compare Crystal Maiden with Phantom Assassin after all. This also eases the navigation for you, as you can quickly jump to the required part of the article to learn about the strongest hero for your role. [![](https://skycoach.gg/storage/uploads/products/description/product_6683e91108b8e.png)](https://skycoach.gg/dota-2-boost/products/dota-2-mmr-boost-duo-2747?utm_source=skycoach.gg&utm_medium=blog&utm_campaign=dota%2Farticles%2Fheroes-tier-list&utm_content=banner&utm_term=mmr) ## Dota 2 Carry Tier List ![](https://skycoach.gg/storage/uploads/products/description/product_66748de94ae09.png) Starting with the most popular role in the game, here is our Dota 2 carry tier list: | | | | --- | --- | | **S-Tier** | Phantom Assassin, Wraith King, Chaos Knight, Lifestealer | | **A-Tier** | Troll Warlord, Juggernaut, Naga Siren, Anti-Mage, Razor, Phantom Lancer,
Faceless Void, Slark, Gyrocopter, Clinkz, Terrorblade, Tiny, Ursa, Spectre | | **B-Tier** | Legion Commander, Luna, Weaver, Sven, Shadow Fiend, Templar Assassin,
Lycan, Morphling, Monkey King | | **C-Tier** | Riki, Medusa, Alchemist | This table has been crafted relying on the data available on the web and our subjective opinion. If you have not found your favorite hero sitting at the expected tier, this is not the end of the day. You can safely enter a match when playing a B-Tier character and still perform exceptionally well. In the long run, everything comes down to your skills and how well you cooperate with the team. ## S-Tier Carry Heroes Explained Currently, you can see four carry heroes sitting in the S-Tier, namely: - Phantom Assassin - Wraith King - Chaos Knight - Lifestealer If not ganked early on or countered properly, Phantom Assassin is the strongest Dota 2 hero you can play in pubs. The reasons stay the same as always. Her Blur is hard to counter at earlier stages of the game, making the enemy’s carry buy Monkey King Bar. As for her ultimate ability, called Coup de Grace, this is where things get deadly. Despite all this, it is still possible to counter Phantom Assassin with Whirling Axes used by Troll Warlord in a melee stance. Wraith King is another strong pick we would advise to beginners playing as carry. This hero’s abilities are straightforward to use and his overall survivability is on a high level. Despite having problems with the mana pool and armor in the early game, he becomes a true beast later on. The real fun starts when you unlock your ultimate ability – Reincarnation. We bet your enemies will not be happy about you having one more life. Chaos Knight is a perfect choice for those who are sure of their luck. Your overall DPS depends on RNG, which can be a big deal to many players who prefer more predictable gameplay. Both your Chaos Bolt and Chaos Strike can turn out to be either too strong or too weak, as well as something in between. Luckily, your Phantasm ultimate ability works in the same way all the time and significantly boosts your damage in the late game. **BLOG20** Lifestealer is kind of similar to Wraith King in terms of how straightforward this hero is. In most cases, you simply activate your Open Wounds and start damaging an enemy while Rage is active. All this is accompanied by your Feast passive, allowing you to restore HP with each successful strike. A combination of these abilities is hard to counter, especially if you have managed to get enough farm early on. ## Dota 2 Midlane Tier List ![](https://skycoach.gg/storage/uploads/products/description/product_6674a97fab95a.png) Moving on to the second popular role in the game, take a look at our Dota 2 midlane tier list: | | | | --- | --- | | **S-Tier** | Templar Assassin, Storm Spirit, Invoker, Ember Spirit | | **A-Tier** | Shadow Fiend, Outworld Destroyer, Meepo, Necrophos, Leshrac, Lone Druid, Kunkka,
Timbersaw, Primal Beast, Zeus, Terrorblade, Huskar, Windranger, Queen of Pain, Visage | | **B-Tier** | Viper, Puck, Pangolier, Monkey King, Dragon Knight, Snapfire, Lina | | **C-Tier** | Tinker, Earth Spirit, Riki, Mirana, Sniper, Pudge, Magnus | Old players would be surprised how our Dota 2 tier list 2026has changed. Not so long ago, people could only think of playing either Pudge or Tinker in this role. Learn from a PRO \\ - Complete Safety \\ - Fair Price \\ \\ $829\\ \\ Buy now](https://skycoach.gg/dota-2-boost/coaching?utm_source=skycoach.gg&utm_medium=blog&utm_content=watch_our_product&utm_campaign=%2Fdota-2%2Farticles%2Fheroes-tier-list&utm_term=Dota%202%20Coaching) ## S-Tier Midlane Heroes Explained So far, the S-Tier midlane heroes include the following ones: - Templar Assassin - Storm Spirit - Invoker - Ember Spirit Despite having many counterpicks, Templar Assassin is one of the most powerful midlaners in Dota 2. Her ability to deal tons of physical damage and make tricky plays can be a great combination in the hands of an experienced player. She can also farm ancient stacks more efficiently than most heroes, thanks to the Psi Blades passive. However, Templar Assassin can be countered by Viper, Venomancer, Jakiro, and other heroes with DoTs. Storm Spirit has been one of the most picked heroes for the mid lane for years. The reason for this is his amazing mobility and versatility in any team composition. Despite all the positive sides, you will have to practice a lot to play this hero effectively. Otherwise, you will always be running without mana and die too often, especially in the early game. Invoker, just like Storm Spirit, is another classic pick if you are a fan of the mid role. At the same time, this is one of the most skill-dependent heroes in the entire game. With a large variety of spells available, you need to learn all the combos to unlock this character’s full potential. At first, learn basic combos like EMP + Tornado, Forge Spirits + Cold Snap, Tornado + Suntrike, and others. Ember Spirit boasts excellent mobility, strong AoE damage, and is hard to kill even in the toughest team fights. However, he is too mana-reliable, especially during the early game. He is also vulnerable to silences and chain stuns. Anyway, if played correctly, you can destroy not only the midlane but the entire map practically solo. ## Dota 2 Offlane Tier List ![](https://skycoach.gg/storage/uploads/products/description/product_6674ac2410436.png) Up next, we suggest you take a look at our Dota 2 offlane tier list: | | | | --- | --- | | **S-Tier** | Mars, Axe, Centaur Warrunner, Legion Commander | | **A-Tier** | Doom, Tidehunter, Vengeful Spirit, Batrider, Timbersaw, Primal Beast,
Darkseer, Night Stalker, Underlord, Visage, Sand King, Magnus | | **B-Tier** | Wraith King, Dawnbreaker, Bristleback, Kunkka, Enigma, Broodmother | | **C-Tier** | Abaddon, Ogre Magi, Tusk, Viper, Pudge, Pugna, Death Prophet | Just like with all other tier lists we have shared above, this one is constantly changing. Your performance can also vary depending on how well you are playing a particular hero. If you mainly play on the offlane, then picking a few characters and mastering them from top to bottom would be the best idea. In this case, you are more likely to learn their mechanics, which will allow you to stay alive during the toughest ganks. ## S-Tier Offlane Heroes Explained In this part of the article, you can find more information about S-Tier offlane heroes from the table above: - Mars - Axe - Centaur Warrunner - Legion Commander Mars is a great pick if you wish to dominate the lane phase rather than hide behind your tower. He can survive tons of physical damage while responding with a variety of disables to the opponents. However, he can be vulnerable to magical/pure damage, especially if focused too hard. Therefore, being too aggressive can be punishable early on. Axe has been a perfect choice for the offlane throughout Dota 2’s history. This massive red orc can make the enemy’s melee carry life much harder. The key ability here is Counter Helix. You use it for farming lanes, jungle, and harass the enemy’s carry. The only problem here is that you lack engaging capabilities. So, the game-changing item you need to get ASAP is Blink Dagger. Centaur Warrunner is great at both the lane and ganking phases. He is also an amazing pick against physical DPS carries like Phantom Assassin, thanks to Retaliate. Your ganking potential is unlocked upon opening the Stampede ultimate. The only problem here is that you will often run out of mana at the worst moment. You are also easily countered by lifesteal heroes like Lifestealer. Legion Commander can become your team’s second carry if you manage to win enough Duels. While on the lane, you can harass the enemy’s carry with Overwhelming Odds. Also, you will win most trades thanks to your Press the Attack and Moment of Courage abilities. Just like Axe, one of the first items you must buy is Blink Dagger. This will let you surprise your enemies with unexpected Duels when they are at low HP. **BLOG20** ## Dota 2 Support Tier List ![](https://skycoach.gg/storage/uploads/products/description/product_6674ae4925f0a.png) If you wish to assist your team, our Dota 2 support tier list is at your service: | | | | --- | --- | | **S-Tier** | Jakiro, Rubick, Dark Willow, Shadow Shaman | | **A-Tier** | Clockwerk, Shadow Demon, Gyrocopter, Spirit Breaker, Phoenix, Weaver,
Skywrath Mage, Marci, Lion, Keeper of the Light, Vengeful Spirit, Chen, Witch Doctor,
Techies, Warlock, Bane, Treant Protector, Hoodwink, Disruptor, Ogre Magi, Earthshaker | | **B-Tier** | Invoker, Zeus, Enigma, Bounty Hunter, Enchantress, Pugna, Pudge, Dazzle, Venomancer, Undying | | **C-Tier** | Omniknight, Nature's Prophet, Enigma, Clinkz, Kunkka | To begin with, having any support in your team is always better than to have none. However, you can pick the strongest heroes just like it is the case with carries, midlaners, and offlaners. Depending on the meta flow, your choice may vary, but some characters like Jakiro have been taking the S-Tier forever. ## S-Tier Support Heroes Explained Currently, we have these four heroes taking the S-Tier in our support tier list: - Jakiro - Rubick - Dark Willow - Shadow Shaman Jakiro has been one of the greatest supports in Dota 2 throughout its different stages. The combination of DoT damage, AoE stun, and the ability to deal plenty of magical damage make them stand out among other heroes. You can safely harass the enemy’s offlaner with Liquid Fire and Dual Breath. Thanks to your Ice Path, ganking becomes an easy thing, as you can stun from the unseen area. Rubick can be an annoying and deadly machine if played correctly. This is one of those heroes you need to practice playing as. Your ultimate ability, Spell Steal, lets you steal enemies’ spells to use against them. Imagine how easily you can turn the game by having ultimates like Ravage, Echo Slam, or Black Hole. Dark Willow is a walking disable that can also easily zone out enemies from afar. Apart from her great supporting capabilities, Dark Willow can deal burst magical damage to slay squishy targets in a few clicks. This hero is also exceptional for ganks at any stage of the game. Shadow Shaman is kind of similar to Jakiro, as this hero was recognized as a great support a long time ago. He has plenty of disables, allowing you to control a chosen enemy until the fight ends. This is possible thanks to Shackles and Hex. At the same time, your Ether Shock and Serpent Wards can deal a ton of damage, especially if enemies keep ignoring your ultimate. ## Best Dota 2 Heroes Overall If you have not chosen your favorite role or wish to try all of them, we have you covered. In this part of the article, you can learn about the best Dota 2 heroes overall. We have outlined the strongest picks for each role you have to try to see how well you are doing in this or that position: 1. Phantom Assassin 2. Storm Spirit 3. Axe 4. Jakiro 5. Ogre Magi We bet you are kind of surprised to see Ogre Magi on this list. However, this character is a great and versatile pick, especially if you are only starting out. They can be played as both support and offlane if necessary. Also, this hero does not have too many spells and their mechanics are more than straightforward. As for other heroes listed above, they are simply the best picks for their roles. If you wish to conquer as many pub games as possible, consider choosing them in most cases. You only want to pick other characters if you see direct counter-picks. For example, you want to play as Axe, but you see the enemy’s team has Lifestealer. If that happens, look for a different hero to play on the offlane. ## F.A.Q. ### Who are the strongest heroes in Dota 2? Here are the most powerful characters in Dota 2: - Phantom Assassin - Storm Spirit - Axe - Jakiro - Ogre Magi ### What is the current meta for Dota 2? Phantom Assassin has been in the center of the meta throughout many patches. This hero is too strong if not countered properly with MKB and specific picks like Troll Warlord. ### Who are the best heroes of the patch in Dota 2? Here are several best heroes to play in the current Dota 2 patch: - Lifestealer - Storm Spirit - Legion Commander - Rubick ### How many heroes are in Dota 2026? Currently, you can select from 127 heroes in Dota 2. Each of them features unique abilities and executes specific roles. ### Which hero to pick in Dota 2? In case you are looking for a strong mid lane pick, try playing as Templar Assassin. This hero is known for her maneuverability and amazing damage boost against multiple targets. ## Did you like the article? ## Counter-picking heroes

This has become a strategy to pick a hero after someone picks so that you can pick a counter to that hero in that game and have an advantage. Counter-picking works most of the times but sometimes doesn't work when you are really countered by the opponent with their better game plan and good team combination. Basically you cant counter a good team work with good heroes but you also need a good team work with your heroes to defeat the opponents.

Anyway i am going to list some of the heroes and their possible counters below so that you can decide if you want to pick some hero to counter them.

[Top](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/guide/heroes-and-their-potential-counters-3572#top)

## heroes and counters (mostly carries)

1\. [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/hero/icon-sm/lifestealer.png) Lifestealer](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/hero/lifestealer-59) looks really scary on the ground,its definitely hard to go against him, his obvious counter item is [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/item/manta-style.png) Manta Style](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/item/manta-style-77) as he is a single target hero and you can kite him down.Another counter to him are the heroes like[![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/hero/icon-sm/naga-siren.png) Naga Siren](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/hero/naga-siren-91)[![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/hero/icon-sm/phantom-lancer.png) Phantom Lancer](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/hero/phantom-lancer-70)[![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/hero/icon-sm/chaos-knight.png) Chaos Knight](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/hero/chaos-knight-85)with lot of illusions and have [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/item/diffusal-blade.png) Diffusal Blade](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/item/diffusal-blade-64); the [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/item/diffusal-blade.png) Diffusal Blade](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/item/diffusal-blade-64) burns all of his mana and renders him useless on the field. [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/item/ghost-scepter.png) Ghost Scepter](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/item/ghost-scepter-46) also prevents him from attacking you for 4 seconds which gives you enough time to go back to other heroes for support

* * *

2\. The same type of strategy goes for [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/hero/icon-sm/ursa.png) Ursa](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/hero/ursa-64). Single target hero so [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/item/manta-style.png) Manta Style](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/item/manta-style-77) confuses him and heroes like[![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/hero/icon-sm/naga-siren.png) Naga Siren](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/hero/naga-siren-91)[![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/hero/icon-sm/phantom-lancer.png) Phantom Lancer](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/hero/phantom-lancer-70)[![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/hero/icon-sm/chaos-knight.png) Chaos Knight](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/hero/chaos-knight-85) are easy counters for him.

* * *

3\. [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/hero/icon-sm/sven.png) Sven](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/hero/sven-2) is another monster in the battle field, he cleaves down most of the heroes easily. It definitely needs some kiting and skills to stomp him down. Counter hero to him are [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/hero/icon-sm/lone-druid.png) Lone Druid](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/hero/lone-druid-90)[![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/hero/icon-sm/bane.png) Bane](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/hero/bane-50)[![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/hero/icon-sm/faceless-void.png) Faceless Void](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/hero/faceless-void-40)[![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/hero/icon-sm/shadow-demon.png) Shadow Demon](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/hero/shadow-demon-104). Other heroes like [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/hero/icon-sm/ursa.png) Ursa](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/hero/ursa-64) and [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/hero/icon-sm/lifestealer.png) Lifestealer](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/hero/lifestealer-59) with some mind games can easily counter him. [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/hero/icon-sm/gyrocopter.png) Gyrocopter](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/hero/gyrocopter-71) with good kiting skills can easily get him down.

* * *

4\. [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/hero/icon-sm/riki.png) Riki](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/hero/riki-62) doesn't have particular counters because any proper carry or nuker can get him down with [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/item/gem-of-true-sight.png) Gem of True Sight](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/item/gem-of-true-sight-50),[![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/item/sentry-ward.png) Sentry Ward](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/item/sentry-ward-41),[![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/item/dust-of-appearance.png) Dust of Appearance](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/item/dust-of-appearance-40) and even the ultimate of [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/hero/icon-sm/slardar.png) Slardar](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/hero/slardar-32) and [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/hero/icon-sm/bounty-hunter.png) Bounty Hunter](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/hero/bounty-hunter-73) can give vision of him.

* * *

5\. [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/hero/icon-sm/phantom-lancer.png) Phantom Lancer](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/hero/phantom-lancer-70) is another strong hero who is hard to stop if he gets a decent farm and not enough death in the early stages of game. Heroes like [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/hero/icon-sm/tiny.png) Tiny](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/hero/tiny-8) with [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/item/aghanims-scepter.png) Aghanim's Scepter](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/item/aghanims-scepter-120)and [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/hero/icon-sm/earthshaker.png) Earthshaker](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/hero/earthshaker-20) can stop him in mid or late game. [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/hero/icon-sm/tiny.png) Tiny](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/hero/tiny-8) with equal amounts of farm as [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/hero/icon-sm/phantom-lancer.png) Phantom Lancer](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/hero/phantom-lancer-70) can actually outcarry him easily. [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/hero/icon-sm/sven.png) Sven](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/hero/sven-2) and [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/hero/icon-sm/kunkka.png) Kunkka](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/hero/kunkka-57) are other two heroes whose cleave effect really puts [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/hero/icon-sm/phantom-lancer.png) Phantom Lancer](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/hero/phantom-lancer-70) in trouble and its obvious counters.

* * *

6\. [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/hero/icon-sm/templar-assassin.png) Templar Assassin](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/hero/templar-assassin-72) is a really good mid hero who can really dominate mid lane and runes easily. Early ganks and everything goes in her teams favour easily. The only advantage she has is that she is strong in early and mid game but this phase of her can also be stopped by [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/hero/icon-sm/pudge.png) Pudge](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/hero/pudge-48) who can go mid against her and an unconventional mid [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/hero/icon-sm/axe.png) Axe](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/hero/axe-45) can really give her hard time and often kill her mid with the [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/skill/axe-battle-hunger.png) Battle Hunger](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/skill/battle-hunger-18). [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/hero/icon-sm/templar-assassin.png) Templar Assassin](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/hero/templar-assassin-72) 's advantage is that she has the shield called [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/skill/templar-assassin-refraction.png) Refraction](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/skill/refraction-313) but the purge effect from [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/item/diffusal-blade.png) Diffusal Blade](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/item/diffusal-blade-64) removes this buff and she becomes easy pray later.

* * *

7\. [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/hero/icon-sm/chaos-knight.png) Chaos Knight](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/hero/chaos-knight-85) is another single target hero who can take down opponents easily. A really good [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/hero/icon-sm/sven.png) Sven](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/hero/sven-2) is the best counter to [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/hero/icon-sm/chaos-knight.png) Chaos Knight](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/hero/chaos-knight-85) and other descent counters include [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/hero/icon-sm/tiny.png) Tiny](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/hero/tiny-8)[![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/hero/icon-sm/earthshaker.png) Earthshaker](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/hero/earthshaker-20)[![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/hero/icon-sm/kunkka.png) Kunkka](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/hero/kunkka-57) . [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/hero/icon-sm/outworld-destroyer.png) Outworld Destroyer](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/hero/outworld-destroyer-103) can also be a problem as he deals 400 % extra damage on illusions

* * *

8\. [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/hero/icon-sm/naga-siren.png) Naga Siren](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/hero/naga-siren-91) is another good carry with image and potential nuke which lowers armour. [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/hero/icon-sm/tiny.png) Tiny](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/hero/tiny-8) is the best counter while [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/hero/icon-sm/sven.png) Sven](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/hero/sven-2) can cleave the hell out of her. Nukes from [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/hero/icon-sm/earthshaker.png) Earthshaker](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/hero/earthshaker-20) can also leave her helpless in battle field with no illusions. The option to counter her is to just run around until her images get over. It's easy as i am saying but not that easy with her net [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/skill/naga-siren-ensnare.png) Ensnare](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/skill/ensnare-346) coming for you.

* * *

When a [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/hero/icon-sm/naga-siren.png) Naga Siren](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/hero/naga-siren-91) is there as your opponent its obvious she is gonna [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/skill/naga-siren-ensnare.png) Ensnare](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/skill/ensnare-346) you from far and take at least 1-2 sec to come up to you,but if you have [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/item/force-staff.png) Force Staff](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/item/force-staff-98) you can move 600 distance again and waste her 1-2 sec more to come upto you. By this strategy you can avoid at least 3-4 sec of her [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/skill/naga-siren-ensnare.png) Ensnare](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/skill/ensnare-346) and the [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/skill/naga-siren-ensnare.png) Ensnare](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/skill/ensnare-346) time she has is of 5 sec when maxed to the most.So her auto attack for 1 or 2 sec wont kill you and you can run from her.

* * *

This is a good idea as i was trolled like this by the opponent team when i farmed with [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/hero/icon-sm/naga-siren.png) Naga Siren](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/hero/naga-siren-91) so much but cant get to the heroes as 3 out of the 5 opponents had [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/item/force-staff.png) Force Staff](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/item/force-staff-98) which really irritated me.

* * *

9\. Skeleton king is another pain if he farms up but his obvious counter is [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/hero/icon-sm/anti-mage.png) Anti-Mage](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/hero/anti-mage-27) who burns his mana and the item [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/item/diffusal-blade.png) Diffusal Blade](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/item/diffusal-blade-64) really stops him from respawning. But a clever skeleton king would keep a [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/item/magic-wand.png) Magic Wand](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/item/magic-wand-53) and [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/item/soul-ring.png) Soul Ring](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/item/soul-ring-60) to save his life. whatever the situation is you should be ready to kill him twice.

* * *

10.[![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/hero/icon-sm/anti-mage.png) Anti-Mage](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/hero/anti-mage-27) is also another hard carry but his early game should go really well or else he is just a piece of cake. Though he has magic resistance, his low hp is a downfall for him and his strength gain is significantly low. therefore he is easy pick early game but he can still run away.

## AXE as a counter

[Your text to link here...](http://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/guide/thats-axe-for-you-ready-to-quot-cull-quot-3412) This is the link to the guide to that fierce early game axe....

Level 6 [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/hero/icon-sm/axe.png) Axe](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/hero/axe-45) with nothing other than the initial starting item can counter these heroes easily with the level 3 [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/skill/axe-battle-hunger.png) Battle Hunger](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/skill/battle-hunger-18) build and 2 levels of [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/skill/axe-counter-helix.png) Counter Helix](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/skill/counter-helix-19) and 1 level [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/skill/axe-culling-blade.png) Culling Blade](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/skill/culling-blade-20) can kill them. The heroes who are prone to die are...[![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/hero/icon-sm/anti-mage.png) Anti-Mage](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/hero/anti-mage-27)[![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/hero/icon-sm/phantom-lancer.png) Phantom Lancer](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/hero/phantom-lancer-70)[![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/hero/icon-sm/phantom-assassin.png) Phantom Assassin](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/hero/phantom-assassin-58)[![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/hero/icon-sm/weaver.png) Weaver](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/hero/weaver-3)[![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/hero/icon-sm/templar-assassin.png) Templar Assassin](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/hero/templar-assassin-72)[![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/hero/icon-sm/luna.png) Luna](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/hero/luna-69)[![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/hero/icon-sm/bounty-hunter.png) Bounty Hunter](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/hero/bounty-hunter-73). >>\> the trick goes in this way---you have to initiate with [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/skill/axe-battle-hunger.png) Battle Hunger](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/skill/battle-hunger-18) if the hero is not close their tower which would put the hero in two minds whether to back up or kill a creep. This mind game would help you. If you see him coming close to deny or last hit; just right click on the hero which would put all the creeps after you resulting in [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/skill/axe-counter-helix.png) Counter Helix](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/skill/counter-helix-19) damaging the hero as well as killing your opponent creeps. If you see his hit point going down you can [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/skill/axe-culling-blade.png) Culling Blade](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/skill/culling-blade-20) him.This would instantly kill him or get him to low hp. If he is on low hp that moment he would run away for sure and you just need to chase him for the time your cooldown for [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/skill/axe-battle-hunger.png) Battle Hunger](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/skill/battle-hunger-18) is up and you can place it on him and guarantee that you would get the kill by the time he reaches back to base..... remember when you are level 6 jungle [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/hero/icon-sm/axe.png) Axe](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/hero/axe-45) the opponent maybe 5 or level 6 and he wont keep a [![](https://www.dotafire.com/images/item/town-portal-scroll.png) Town Portal Scroll](https://www.dotafire.com/dota-2/item/town-portal-scroll-110) for sure.

Did you know that you can use an app which updates your picks automatically?

[AutoPicker - Read More](http://dotapicker.com/tutorials/autopicker)

# About dotapicker

This is a **counter pick** web application for [Dota 2](http://www.dota2.com/).
It shows the advantage percentages against a hero or team.

Advantage measures the matchup between two heroes regardless of their normal win rate. It is calculated by establishing their win rates both in and outside of the matchup and comparing the difference against a base win rate.

The picker is designed to be a very simple single page application, without reload, so that you can instantly see the result and **counter pick** your enemies before matches.

If you need both counter picking and team synergy, lane and role selectors, winrate mode, advantage graphs or hero matchups you should use the [Counter & Synergy Picker](http://dotapicker.com/herocounter).


Based on [github](https://github.com/onuraslan/DotaBuffCP).

# Counter picks of all Dota 2 heroes

01.02.2023

12 178

41min.

One of the most important stages of professional **Dota 2** games is the draft. If this is not so important in amateur games, then in eSports, at the stage of character picking, you can develop an effective game strategy. This happens due to the fact that in such games the individual skills of each gamer fade into the background, giving way to the team skill. Victory is achieved by the effective interaction of the heroes, as well as their ability to neutralize the strengths of the enemy.

**Interaction and neutralization of abilities in Dota 2**

Under the effective interaction of heroes is meant their ability to complement each other. A simple example would be **Frostbite** ( _Crystal Maiden_), which stops the target and deals low damage, in conjunction with 2 abilities – **Meat Hook** ( _Pudge_) or **Sacred Arrow** ( _Mirana_). They make a big contribution to the successful killing of the enemy, but it is very difficult to hit a moving target using this abilities. By combining them correctly, you can achieve maximum result.

The ability to neutralize the strengths of the enemy means the use of abilities that prevent the enemy from reaching his potential or allow him to be destroyed as efficiently as possible. For example, **Culling Blade** ( _Axe_) makes it impossible for _Huskar_ to feel safe at low health while affected by his **Berserker’s Blood** passive ability.

A **counterpick** is the choice of a character who is able to neutralize the advantages of the enemy hero, effectively resist him or wrap his strong side in his favor.

We bring to your attention some examples of counter-picks of Dota 2 heroes with a description:

**Crystal Maiden**

This heroine is characterized by high magic damage from a long-term ultimate ability. A good counter would be a character who is able to interrupt its use. It can be any hero with a skill that silences or banishes the enemy to the astral plane. For example, Drow Ranger, Death Prophet, Silencer, Night Stalker, Outworld Devourer and Shadow Demon.

**Ancient Apparition**

This hero has strong abilities to control the enemy and strengthen allied characters. However, Ancient Apparition has low health and low mobility. The most effective way to counter is to take him out of the game as soon as possible, without giving him the opportunity to express himself in battles. Heroes who can quickly and discreetly detect Ancient Apparition in enemy territory, as well as those with high physical damage, are suitable for this task. Examples of such heroes are: Clinkz, Phantom Assassin, Anti-Mage, Storm Spirit, and Broodmother.

**Invoker**

This character has an extensive arsenal of spells and a large mana pool. There are several ways to effectively resist him: blocking the ability to cast spells, using Invoker’s magical power against himself, and also gaining abilities that protect against magic. Such characters are Anti-Mage, Nyx Assassin, Pugna, Doom Bringer, Silencer, Lifestealer, Juggernaut.

**Pudge**

Pudge has strong single target destruction abilities. With a high health pool and high magical defense, he remains weak against physical attacks. Therefore, a good counter pick for Pudge is a character with a lot of illusions. For example, Phantom Lancer, Chaos Knight, Naga Siren. Lifestealer also counters this hero. He possesses an ability which grants spell immunity and passive lifesteal based on the target’s health. That is why he is considered one of the strongest picks.

**Riki, Clinkz, Nyx Assassin, Broodmother**

All of these heroes have the ability to become invisible. To neutralize this advantage, you need characters that can remove this effect from enemies or give vision to invisible units in the area. This could be Zeus, Slardar, Blood Seeker, or Bounty Hunter himself with his Track ability.

**Shadow Fiend**

Taking advantage of SF’s weakness in the first minutes of the game, you can seize the advantage, preventing him from developing. To do this, pick such heroes as Templar Assassin, Zeus, Outworld Devourer. In the long run, the fight against Shadow Fiend is effective with Ursa, Clockwerk and Luna.

**Sven**

To fight Sven, you need to effectively distribute the damage coming from him or be able to turn off the ultimate ability. For direct combat, characters such as Troll Warlord, Bristleback, Templar Assassin, Wraith King, Medusa are suitable. Among the heroes of the second line are Oracle, Shadow Demon, Winter Wyvern, Keeper of the Light.

**Phantom Lancer**

This hero is weak against characters who have abilities or area-of-effect attacks. These include Meepo, Timbersaw, Necrophos, Ember Spirit, Puck, Pangolier, Axe, Underlord, Sven.

**Phantom Assassin**

To fight this heroine, you will need high mobility, magic damage and the ability to deprive her of the chance to attack. Morphling, Meepo, Tinker, Tidehunter, Axe, Pugna are suitable for this purpose.

**Omniknight**

He is considered a strong support hero. However, Omniknight is weak in 1v1 combat and has low mana. If you deprive him of the ability to use 2 basic abilities, he becomes an easy target. Omniknight is opposed by Outworld Devourer, Anti-Mage, Nature’s Prophet, Doom, Faceless Void, Dark Seer.

**Morphing**

He does not have decent protection against magical damage and often has low health. Characters with strong offensive skills and silence spells are most effective against him. These are Outworld Devourer, Puck, Tinker, Queen of Pain, Storm Spirit, Ancient Apparition, Techies, Axe.

**Meepo**

He is weak against 2 types of characters: who have strong AoE damage and magic defense. If Meepo is deprived of his abilities, he becomes extremely vulnerable. His main counter picks are: Shadow Fiend, Huskar, Sven, Pangolier, Kunkka, Elder Titan, Earthshaker, Jakiro, Winter Wyvern.

**Bounty Hunter**

He is very weak against a large number of opponents (spears, illusions), weakly protected from magical attacks. He can be beaten by: Huskar, Chaos Knight, Legion Commander, Storm Spirit, Slark, Necrophos, Naga Siren, Meepo, Queen of Pain, Phantom Lancer, Slardar, Outworld Devourer.

**Doom**

He has a low mana pool and is distinguished by abilities that are aimed at a single target. Characters with illusions or heroes independent of their active spells are great as a counter pick: Chaos Knight, Slardar, Meepo, Anti-Mage, Specter, Queen of Pain, Naga Siren, Lone Druid, Wraith King, Broodmother, Razor, Lifestealer, Terrorblade, Arc Warden.

**Drow Ranger**

He has a low health pool and an attack directed at a single target. Spells that deal a lot of damage and characters with illusions or summoned creatures will help. Drow Ranger’s counter picks are: Phantom Lancer, Tinker, Wraith King, Phantom Assassin, Chaos Knight, Nature’s Prophet, Broodmother, Zeus, Bloodseeker, Arc Warden.

**Sand King**

To effectively counter Sand King, you need a combination of 2 factors: the presence of an ability that removes the state of invisibility, as well as high protection against magical damage. For example, Lifestealer, Sniper, Centaur Warrunner, Arc Warden, Viper, Zeus, Bristleback, Faceless Void, Alchemist, Clinkz, Anti-Mage, Juggernaut, Timbersaw, Bloodseeker are suitable.

**Sniper**

He has a high attack range, but does not have a significant amount of health points. Characters who can quickly close the distance to the target are effective against the Sniper: Nature’s Prophet, Storm Spirit, Broodmother, Lycan, Phantom Assassin, Zeus, Morphling, Tinker, Earth Spirit, Centaur Warrunner, Spirit Breaker, Clinkz, Specter.

**Techies**

This hero places mines on the map that deal high instant damage, so it is effective against characters with low health. For a counter pick, you should choose heroes with a lot of health and high magic defense: Lone Druid, Centaur Warrunner, Lifestealer, Specter, Bristleback, Arc Warden, Medusa, Dragon Knight, Templar Assassin, Huskar, Wraith King, Chaos Knight.

**Timbersaw**

He is strongly dependent on the frequent use of skills, has a high resistance to physical damage. So, heroes that can silence and deal magic damage turn out to be effective against Timbersaw. These are Outworld Devourer, Gyrocopter, Weaver, Leshrac, Medusa, Arc Warden, Razor, Silencer, Death Prophet, Shadow Fiend, Puck, Ursa, Bloodseeker, Brewmaster, Queen of Pain.

**Ursa**

Has great potential in one-on-one battles. If you deprive Ursa of the ability to attack the only true target or hit it, she loses her advantage. You should choose Naga Siren, Wraith King, Razor, Slardar, Troll Warlord, Necrophos, Terrorblade, Broodmother, Weaver, Bristleback, Windranger, Tinker, Riki, Brewmaster, Phantom Lancer, Beastmaster.

**Wraith King**

He is capable of immediately resurrecting after death, if the amount of remaining mana allows. In the game, depriving him of this opportunity, as well as dispersing his attention with a large number of illusions, will help. When choosing a character against Wraith King, you should pay attention to Anti-Mage, Bristleback, Timbersaw, Slark, Lone Druid, Alchemist, Broodmother, Terrorblade, Brewmaster, Lifestealer, Pangolier, Invoker, Naga Siren, Phantom Lancer, Meepo.

**Tips for Dota 2 players**

Correct and timely counter picks are one of the main indicators of the high level of skills of the captain of any esports team in Dota 2. By carefully watching the counter peaks of each side, you can predict the outcome even before the match starts. Analyze the game of professional esportsmen to improve yourself and choose the most suitable heroes for each match.

DotaCounters employs a high-frequency compositional analysis engine. While many drafting tools rely on static,
infrequently updated winrate snapshots, our platform utilizes a dynamic state-space integration model.
Key architectural strengths:
\- \*\*Data Freshness\*\*: The underlying meta-mapping repository is updated daily,
ensuring recommendations reflect the current competitive landscape.
\- \*\*Dataset Breadth\*\*: Recommendations are derived from a training corpus of millions of unique competitive
matches, providing statistical significance far beyond standard benchmark datasets.
\- \*\*Computational Modeling\*\*: Our engine analyzes compositional synergies and counters in real-time,
offering a high-fidelity alternative to simple winrate lookup tables.
